limitations: This refresh and audit do not scan raw captures or execute simulation.
Historical 33245-check review was an artifact audit, not fresh raw evidence.
Repeated variants reuse captures; cohort-weighted event totals are not independent coverage.
Per-call acceptance applies to each cohort mean, not to every event in the cohort.
Reference, unmatched and failed prediction rows remain outside acceptance denominators.
Family averages are descriptive; failing cohorts cannot cancel in signed averages.
Activity sums overlap and are not model latency or throughput.
No tolerance floor or timing adjustment was added to any prediction.
Recomputed family sums may differ by floating-point rounding; original comparison values are exact.
